blocks.title: Linear regression
blocks.text: Linear regression do variables ke rishte ka model hai ta ke ek se doosre ki pesh-goi ho: Y = b0 + b1 X + error, jahan Y dependent variable, X independent variable, b0 intercept (X = 0 par Y), b1 slope (X ki har ikai par Y ki tabdeeli) aur error asal aur andaze ka farq hai.

blocks.caption: Phal ka stall: customers aur rozana kamai

blocks.text: Har 5 izafi customers 200 rupay barhate hain, to slope b1 = 200 / 5 = 40 rupay fi customer. 10 customers aur 500 rupay se: 500 = b0 + 40 x 10, to b0 = 100, baghair customers ke bunyadi kamai. Model: earnings = 100 + 40 x customers. 22 customers par andaza 100 + 880 = 980 rupay. Chhatay din 28 customers se 1,250 rupay mile jabke model ne 100 + 1,120 = 1,220 kaha; ghalti 30 rupay (asal minus andaza), jo dikhata hai ke asal data badalta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: customers banam earnings ke paanch nuqte line earnings = 100 + 40 x customers par, 22 customers par Rs 980 ki prediction aur chhatay din ka asal nuqta 1,250. Oopar daen: 1 se 6 ghante parhai ke pass/fail nuqton par S-shakal imkan ka curve. Neeche baen: paanch students ke Math aur English scores do K-means clusters mein, markaz x se. Neeche daen: model banane ke paanch qadam.
blocks.caption: Linear regression, logistic regression aur K-means (topic 5.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Phal ke stall ka data bilkul line earnings = 100 + 40 x customers par hai, to 22 customers par 980 rupay ki prediction, aur chhatay din model ne 28 customers ke liye 1,220 kaha jabke asal 1,250 the. Logistic model parhai ke ghanton ko pass hone ke imkan mein badalta hai jo 0 ke qareeb se 1 ke qareeb tak S-shakal mein barhta aur fail aur pass students ke darmiyan 0.5 paar karta hai; banaya gaya curve wazahati hai. K = 2 ke saath K-means Basim, Umer aur Maliha ko Math 78.3, English 65 ke markaz par, aur Anie aur Tallat ko Math 45, English 82.5 par jama karta hai. Model masla tay karne, data jama karne, algorithm chunne, train karne aur naye data par jaanchne se banta hai.

blocks.prompt: Bunyadi statistical model kaunsa hai (MCQ 1)? Slope kya dikhata hai (MCQ 5)? Pesh-goi ka ek bunyadi model bata kar us ka maqsad samjhaiye (short question 2).
blocks.explanation: (a) linear regression; (b) independent variable ki ek ikai badalne par dependent variable ki tabdeeli. Linear regression seedhi line baitha kar ek variable se doosre adadi nateeje ki pesh-goi karta hai, maslan customers ki tadaad se stall ki kamai.

items: Linear regression: earnings = 100 + 40 x customers; 22 customers par Rs 980; chhatay din ki ghalti Rs 30.
